text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono.
Pray, lend me your ear.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "Due to the recent string of consecutive races, fatigue has piled up, resulting in a continuous lack of concentration."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
It is purely due to my own inadequacy, but
if I may be so bold, might I request some rest?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate,
I will be unable to fulfill my liege's command.
...Please, reconsider the race schedule."

"Durandal seems to have accumulated quite a bit of fatigue
from running race after race.
Perhaps we should reconsider her upcoming race schedule."
